abstract: Covers the Content Signals Policy, Cloudflare's CC0 robots.txt addition for stating whether content may be used for search, ai-input and ai-train, pinned to the policy announced on 24 September 2025 and the contentsignals.org generator. The 2025 policy is the only line. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions and the syntax, presets, parsing and combining rules.

sources.title: Giving users choice with Cloudflare's new Content Signals Policy
